claim_scope: Original stylized geological/mineral/process concept, not exact site reconstruction or a named organism.

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: twelve-metre representative landscape extent with a broad cropped shore-connected root narrowing into one projecting low sand tongue and a curved free tip. One continuous closed land mesh, no independent island or second shore attachment/tombolo; broad and narrow macro contours carry the identity rather than ripple noise. Original nominal extent, crest heights, curvature and sand palette, not a complete mapped coast, exact ancient place/age or sediment-transport simulation. Water and display scenery are not included. Original landscape/coast facets preserved.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：十二米代表性landscape范围，以宽阔截取的连岸根部渐收成单条低矮狭长沙舌及弯曲自由端。单一连续封闭陆体网格，不是独立小岛，也没有第二端连岸/连岛沙洲关系；主要识别来自宽窄宏观轮廓而非波纹噪声。范围、脊高、弯曲及沙色为原创名义设定，不是完整海岸测绘、精确古地点/年代或输沙模拟。不混入水体与展示场景。保留原始landscape/coast分类。
